name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It catches routing flaws early, before they compound. The trade-off is delayed feedback on older PRs, but catching fresh errors prevents wider damage.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the newest open PR risks exposing *new* edge cases that could destabilize the main branch if the PR merges before fixes propagate. Better to run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *all* open PRs for a week to catch systemic flaws, not just the latest. Settle it by measuring error rates in staging after both approaches—lower errors win.
